caption: The video captures a surfer in a dark-red wetsuit crouched low on his board, riding inside the hollow barrel of a large, slow-breaking green ocean wave. A pale overcast sky hangs above, and choppy grey water fills the foreground. The wave's curling lip and a curtain of white foam dominate the right side of the frame. The rider holds a braced stance with one arm extended for balance as he drifts steadily leftward and slightly downward within the tube. The breaking whitewater grows and advances leftward, narrowing the open barrel and progressively occluding the surfer. Around the middle, a second person's head and shoulder, clad in a dark wetsuit with one hand raised near the head, enter the bottom-right corner and remain visible thereafter. The pale sky stays overcast while the distant horizon drifts slowly downward, a slight camera tilt rather than a large sweep, so the dominant motion comes from the wave's closing break and the rider's travel inside it. By the end, only a small portion of the rider is still visible through the narrowing gap.

draft_caption: The video captures a surfer in a dark-red wetsuit crouched low on his board, riding inside the hollow barrel of a large, slow-breaking green ocean wave. A pale overcast sky hangs above, and choppy grey water fills the foreground. The wave's curling lip and a curtain of white foam dominate the right side of the frame. The rider holds a braced stance with one arm extended for balance as he drifts steadily leftward and slightly downward within the tube. The breaking whitewater grows and advances leftward, narrowing the open barrel and progressively occluding the surfer. Around the middle of the excerpt, a second person's head and shoulder, clad in a dark wetsuit with one hand raised near the head, enter the bottom-right corner and remain for the rest of the clip. The pale sky and distant horizon stay essentially fixed. The visible motion therefore comes from the wave's closing break and the rider's travel inside it rather than any large camera sweep. By the final frames only a small portion of the rider is still visible through the narrowing gap.
